summary: Jungwon Air Base/Chungju Airport is a dual-use military and civilian facility operated primarily by the Republic of Korea Air Force in the inland Chungcheongbuk-do province. It serves the Chungju region and accommodates limited commercial aviation alongside its defense role, making it one of the smaller operational airports in central South Korea.
